bit_order: Raw strings are MSB first; c[0] is the rightmost bit. Component labels use the reversed listed classical_bits_lsb_first order.
evidence_boundary: Completed hardware acquisition recovered retrospectively. Original approval, local pre-submission archive, calibration, and preregistration are unavailable.
ideal_scope: Exact Gaussian-integer amplitudes for the actual decoded QPY circuit, with exhaustive mid-measurement/reset/Clbit-condition branches. Components contain at most three qubits; Qiskit Statevector gate evolution independently cross-checks every active component. Product ideal laws assume ideal isolated components, not measured hardware independence. Exact RZ phases interpret numeric pi/2 multiples within the checked 1e-12 quarter-turn tolerance.

spectators.ideal_joint_law: all measurement-only spectator bits are zero

statistical_scope: Wilson 95% intervals are marginal binomial descriptions under independent identical shot sampling. They are neither simultaneous nor preregistered. Shot drift and shared-resource dependence remain unmodeled; pairwise statistics describe same-PUB shot vectors. PUB shot indices are not paired across PUBs.
